session.title: Suito 3x8 tempo/torque development
session.purpose: Provide the conference week's explicit aerobic-development stimulus so five bike touches do not become two training days surrounded by recovery-only riding.

dose.admission_gate: Execute only if Monday stayed within two cycles and 130 minutes with no late technical fade or triggered-but-continued outcome, Tuesday's easy touch improved or preserved leg feel, Wednesday physical readiness is green, CNS is ready or normal, clarity is at least 8/10 and there is no illness, pain or gastrointestinal disturbance.
dose.warm_up: 12-15 minutes progressive seated riding from 105 W toward 140 W.
dose.main_set: 3x8 minutes seated at 165-170 W, cadence 70-75 rpm and RPE 5-6, with 4 minutes at 100-115 W between reps. Rep three may rise toward 175 W only if rep two finishes at RPE 5 or lower with stable HR, cadence and posture.
dose.fallback: If the admission gate is not clean, replace the main set with 50-60 minutes at 116-130 W and RPE 2-3; do not relocate the structured work later in the conference week.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A controlled 24-minute tempo/torque dose at 78-81 percent of the current 211 W Garmin operational FTP will rebuild sustained bike-specific aerobic and muscular durability without the recovery cost of VO2 intervals before Friday's Enduro transfer.
execution_rules: Use strong fan cooling, remain seated and keep the 12 mm aft saddle position unchanged.
Take a normal carbohydrate-containing meal beforehand and drink approximately 500-750 ml per hour.
Do not add standing torque, cadence drills, a fourth rep or extra watts because the first two feel easy.

expected_result.session: All three reps stay within roughly 3 percent power spread, cadence and posture remain stable, and final RPE is no higher than 6.
expected_result.next_day: No residual CNS, sleep, knee, back, hand or leg cost that threatens Friday's controlled Enduro session.

stop_rules: Use the fallback when the admission gate fails.
End the structured set for pain, abnormal HR response, posture or cadence collapse, power loss above 5 percent, or if rep two already exceeds RPE 6.
Any residual Thursday fatigue removes the Thursday primer and may reduce Friday to one controlled cycle.
